The name Darun, symbolizing protection of the forest, embodies the Hindu belief in harmonious coexistence with nature. Darun may also point towards a respect for the preservation and conservation of natural resources, which has been a vital aspect of Indian culture and philosophy from time immemorial.

The forest, being a metaphor for the self, harbors untamed thoughts, emotions, desires, and instincts. Darun can then represent an individual's effort to maintain the balance and harmony within, residing constant awareness of their thoughts and actions, and working towards the betterment of their consciousness. The name thus serves as a reminder to stay aligned with the higher self, protecting it from negative influences, keeping it healthy and strong.
